title: Early use of dapagliflozin in patients with acute myocardial infarction and reduced ejection fraction: the randomized ARMYDA-9 Dapagliflozin trial
official: Early use of dapagliflozin in patients with acute myocardial infarction and reduced ejection fraction: the randomized ARMYDA-9 Dapagliflozin trial
summary: Main objective: The aim will be to study the potential cardioprotective effects (primarily the reduction of the infarct size) of an early use of the SGLT-2 inhibitor, to evaluate its safety (occurrence of a composite event including cardiovascular death, worsening of heart failure during hospitalization, myocardial re-infarction, stroke, or unplanned coronary revascularization) and side effects
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥18 years
2. STEMI regardless of the involved epicardial territories
3. Primary PCI <12 hours from symptom onset
4. TIMI coronary flow 0-1 at the time of primary PCI
5. Imaging evidence of new regional wall motion abnormality and LVEF ≤40% by ventriculography performed at the time of primary PCI or by trans-thoracic echocardiography performed as soon as possible within 12 hours from admission
6. Written informed consent to participate the study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Cardiogenic shock on admission
2. Pregnancy or breastfeeding. For women of childbearing potential, any pregnancy status must be ascertained with a pregnancy test during the screening or randomization visit
3. Participation in a clinical trial in which an investigational drug was administered within 30 days of screening or in the 5 half-lives of the study drug, whichever is longer
4. Symptomatic hypotension or blood pressure <90 mmHg
5. History of restrictive cardiomyopathy, constrictive pericarditis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy or untreated severe heart valve disease
6. History of diabetic ketoacidosis, secondary diabetes or type 1 diabetes
7. History of heart failure with NYHA IV
8. Severe hepatic insufficiency
9. Active cancer
10. eGFR<30 ml/min
11. Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients
